subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should durable OpenClaw memory use across memory-core, QMD, MEMORY.md promotion, Memory Wiki inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but source authority, data model ownership, merge/edit lineage, and plugin boundary semantics are product/API choices that automation should not lock in alone.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before implementation.

options.title: Sequence Through Schema Foundation
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 the prerequisite for record/revision ownership, then implement provenance once the schema shape is settled.

options.title: Use Memory Wiki As Optional Layer
options.body: Document Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across memory host SDK, promotion, and product-boundary changes relevant to this contract.
